GENERAL SCIENCE — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #17
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: GENERAL SCIENCE
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Gaseous Exchange in Human Beings ● Structure, functions and adaptations of the h? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Gaseous Exchange in Human Beings ● Structure, functions and adaptations of the h.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Gaseous Exchange in Human Beings ● Structure, functions and adaptations of the h.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Gaseous Exchange in Human Beings ● Structure, functions and adaptations of the h.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Gaseous Exchange in Human Beings ● Structure, functions and adaptations of the h.

2. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   B. Water always increases oxygen
   C. Petrol fires have no fuel
   D. Water removes heat too quickly

3. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. A mixture of two liquids
   B. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   C. Any white crystal used in cooking
   D. Any substance that conducts electricity

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Thin Lenses ● Types of lenses ● Properties of thin lenses (principal focus, opti? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Thin Lenses ● Types of lenses ● Properties of thin lenses (principal focus, opti.

   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Thin Lenses ● Types of lenses ● Properties of thin lenses (principal focus, opti.

5. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   B. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   C. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   D. A mixture always has a fixed melting point

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Hydrocarbons ● Classification of hydrocarbons ● General formula and Nomenclature? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Hydrocarbons ● Classification of hydrocarbons ● General formula and Nomenclature.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Hydrocarbons ● Classification of hydrocarbons ● General formula and Nomenclature.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Hydrocarbons ● Classification of hydrocarbons ● General formula and Nomenclature.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Hydrocarbons ● Classification of hydrocarbons ● General formula and Nomenclature.

7. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. newton (N)
   B. joule (J)
   C. watt (W)
   D. pascal (Pa)

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Human Reproduction? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Human Reproduction.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Human Reproduction.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Human Reproduction.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Human Reproduction.

11. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Decomposers only
   B. Primary consumers only
   C. Producers
   D. Tertiary consumers

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Sensory and endocrine system in Human Beings ● The structure and functions of se? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Sensory and endocrine system in Human Beings ● The structure and functions of se.

----
